- **`getAppKeysFromSlug`** (`packages/app-store/_utils/getAppKeysFromSlug.ts`) finds the app by slug and gives back an empty object when there's no such app. The new function already uses it.
- **`getParsedAppKeysFromSlug`** (`packages/app-store/_utils/getParsedAppKeysFromSlug.ts:6`) wraps the same lookup but checks the keys against a `zod` schema and throws if `client_id` is missing. - **`isPrismaObj` and `hasKeyInMetadata`** only check whether a value is an object or whether `metadata` has a key. Neither one returns a string field, so they don't help here.
